requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier passes DELETE/TRASH/HARDLINK/SYMLINK action constants through actions and checks each disposition's landing effect.
must_include: TRASH (move to trash via an injectable callable)
HARDLINK (delete the copy, then hardlink to the keeper)
SYMLINK (delete the copy, then symlink to the keeper)

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks SIZE_ONLY vs FULL identity strengths (and tolerates PARTIAL).
must_include: FULL (compare up to full content, sampled digests for big files)

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier constructs ScanSpec with keyword args and checks filtering by ext.
Verifier calls CandidateScanner(spec).scan() and expects InvalidScanRootError for a missing root.
must_include: .scan() returns a list of candidates in deterministic order
raises InvalidScanRootError when a scan root does not exist

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier builds candidates via candidate_from_path and checks .identity() and same_content().
Verifier checks the tiered size->partial->full comparison semantics.
Verifier calls group_identical and checks per-group reclaimable bytes and protected-group zero.
must_include: the reclaimable bytes (total size of all copies except the keeper
if the whole group is protected, reclaimable is 0
groups that can free more space listed first

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks tiny/empty files ignored by default and the adjustable threshold down to 0.
must_include: Files too small (below a very small default threshold, e.g. empty files) are ignored by default
adjustable by the caller (including down to 0)

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks scan result order is deterministic.
must_include: Scan result order must be deterministic

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks reference-dir files are protected/never reclaimed and excluded dirs not scanned.
must_include: files in directories marked 'reference' are protected
Excluded directories are not scanned at all

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier calls make_strategy and expects UnknownStrategyError for bad names.
Verifier checks each named keeper strategy.
Verifier checks composed strategies with preferred_dir tuple and tie-breaking.
must_include: earlier ones take priority, later ones break ties

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks cleanest_name picks the non-copy-looking name.
Verifier checks protected/reference files are always kept, never reclaimed.
must_include: Protected (reference) files are always kept preferentially and never become reclaim targets

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier builds a plan via ReclaimPlanner and checks ReclaimAction.reclaimed_bytes.
Verifier checks ReclaimPlan.actions ordering, .keepers, .victim_count.
must_include: actions[0].reclaimed_bytes is the single-copy size of the largest group

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks planning/previewing never modifies the filesystem.
Verifier checks ReclaimExecutor().execute(plan) raises ProtectedPathError on a protected target.
Verifier checks dry-run makes no changes but returns same-structure result.
must_include: Dry-run performs all checks a real execution would but skips actual changes

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks staleness refusal by default and skip when ignored.
must_include: re-verify each file to be reclaimed still matches the planning snapshot
refuse and raise an error by default
recorded as skipped rather than crashing

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks re-running an executed plan is a no-op / already-reclaimed.
must_include: re-running an already-executed plan is a no-op
treated as already reclaimed, not an error

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier injects a fake trash callable for TRASH actions.
must_include: Trash actions must go through an injectable, replaceable callable

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier constructs ReclaimSession with keyword args including strength=FULL.
Verifier checks analyze() result fields group_count/duplicate_count/reclaimable_bytes/plan.
Verifier checks apply() uses exactly the previewed plan and staleness behavior.
must_include: using exactly the plan from analyze()
with ignore_stale=True it is recorded as skipped

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks execution report .dry_run/.done_count/.skipped_count.
Verifier checks duplicate_count equals member count minus one summed.
must_include: redundant copies = sum of each group's member count minus one

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks deep-merge: scalar override, list append, None delete.
must_include: list-type fields (such as roots, include_ext, etc.) are append-merged
a key explicitly set to None means delete that key

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks load_session builds a session from layered documents.
must_include: action takes one of the action constants

requirements.verifier_assertion: Verifier checks the four exported exception types.
Verifier checks report.as_dict includes plan.victim_count and plan.reclaimable_bytes.
Verifier checks report.render_text output contains 'Reclaimable'.
